ITEM 1 | Bright green baby spinach leaves, flat and tender, with smooth surfaces and visible central stems, covering most of the bowl's lower and right side, lying loosely with some overlap | 60
ITEM 2 | Bright green broccoli florets, small bite-sized clusters about 2-3 cm across with rough, bumpy tops and pale green stalks, scattered over the spinach | 75
ITEM 3 | Cooked light tan-white chicken pieces, cut into cubes about 1-1.5 cm, with slightly fibrous texture and a matte, moist surface, mixed among the greens | 70
